new_value: {"notes":"Lane C2-migrate 2026-10-22: implemented 'git-vouch-migrate verify-continuity --commit C --signer FPR PGPKEYS REGISTRY [HANDLE...]' and verify_continuity(pgp, root, handles) -\u003e Continuity(proven, failed, duplicates) for vouch-omzm.3 to import. SSH side = vouch.check_registry(root).people (valid person files) + vouch.signer_of per .sig block; nothing reimplemented. GPG side: key in pgpkeys@C not revoked/invalid (expired ok, D9), every file email on an unrevoked UID, then proof = (a) a .sig block by a current unrevoked person key equal to gpg --export-ssh-key of a live ed25519/P-256 auth subkey (the auth subkey must SIGN; listing a public subkey proves nothing), else (b) .asc: one detached class-00 signature, GOODSIG or EXPKEYSIG (gpg exits 0 for both; REVKEYSIG/BADSIG/NO_PUBKEY/ERRSIG/EXPSIG rejected), VALIDSIG primary == migratedFrom. D3: fingerprint (case-normalised) claimed by \u003e1 valid person file fails all claimants. Exit 1 if any reported handle fails. Tests: tests/migrate/test_continuity.py (13; real gpg, ssh-keygen, gpg-agent ssh socket for auth-subkey signing). Fixture: frank is now revoked only in pgpkeys keys/, not in the signing home (port output unchanged). Mutation-checked: each rule's removal fails a test. Smoke: real pgpkeys@af88128 with empty registry runs in ~10s. Not closed (later stage)."}
